decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: One Northern Lights transport-and-storage system, not each development phase, vessel or customer capture plant. First injection, grant-agreement completion and run-in outcomes remain distinct. Cargo quality is a specification; the old lifecycle model is prospective and excludes upstream capture/liquefaction.

One post-2020 municipality, not the former smaller Øygarden or the terminal. September and November 2026 road updates supersede the earlier opening forecast without inventing a replacement date. Public-water coverage and a risk assessment are not measured service continuity.

One Rotterdam municipality, not its metropolitan region or the full water-board area. Local storage, dyke exposure, wastewater treatment and industrial freshwater remain separate systems. Benthemplein and port indicators add no extra identities or citywide resilience score.

review_checks: Sixteen official or primary-source records inspected November 22 in America/Edmonton. Owner, operator, government, municipal and commissioned-model sources retain their distinct roles.

Norwegian Bokmål/Nynorsk and Dutch terms were interpreted by the author; bilingual and English sources retain their languages. This is AI author self-review, not independent or human native-language review, and adds no translated-reading count.

The one-page liquid specification and relevant complete lifecycle-assessment and municipal risk-assessment sections were read as text. Screenshot calls returned no inspectable image; no visual verification is claimed.

The Northern Lights 2025 annual PDF was retrieved but its text extraction reversed word order. It was not used for substantive claims or throughput values. No outside annual-throughput estimate was imported from a secondary source.

Chronologies distinguish August 2025 first injection, October 1 completion confirmation and October 29 announcement, March 2026 pilot/construction updates, 2020 municipal merger and November 12 meeting from its November 20 page update.

The source's 2023 lifecycle model starts with already-liquefied cargo and has an older expansion configuration. Its estimate is not an observed full-chain removal rate. Capacity and specification values remain distinct from operating measurements.

Three substantive articles contain eighteen sections, eleven sourced chronology events and three next-artifact requests each. The roads, terminals, local basins and former municipalities are contextual, not additional counts.

The Norway project/place and Netherlands place dockets gain additive current notices. Their original Phase 191/192 files, older eligibility decisions, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and current evidence receipts remain intact. No launch, publication, new cycle identity or measured-series admission is implied.
